#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if ! command -v bambu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[NOT_RUN] FR-4: bambu not found"
  exit 0
fi

mkdir -p tests
LOG=tests/bambu.log
set +e
bambu -v0 --top-fname=check_token -O3 check_token.cpp >"$LOG" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e

if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "[PASS] FR-4"
  exit 0
fi

# Infra/toolchain missing headers etc.
if grep -Eq "fatal error:.*file not found|asm/errno\.h|No such file or directory" "$LOG"; then
  echo "[NOT_RUN] FR-4: synthesis infrastructure error (missing headers/sysroot)"
  exit 0
fi

# Tool internal crash
if grep -Eq "Segmentation fault|internal error|map::at|terminate called|Assertion.*failed" "$LOG"; then
  echo "[NOT_RUN] FR-4: synthesis tool internal error"
  exit 0
fi

echo "[FAIL] FR-4: synthesis/design error (see tests/bambu.log)"
exit 2

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "[NOT_RUN] COSIM: not configured in this benchmark bundle"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SRC="check_token.cpp"
rc=0

fail(){ echo "[FAIL] $1: $2"; rc=1; }
pass(){ echo "[PASS] $1"; }

[ -f "$SRC" ] || { fail FR2 "missing $SRC"; fail FR3 "missing $SRC"; fail FR4 "missing $SRC"; fail SR1 "missing $SRC"; fail SR2 "missing $SRC"; fail SR3 "missing $SRC"; fail SR4 "missing $SRC"; fail SR5 "missing $SRC"; exit 1; }

# Extract check_token body (best-effort)
BODY=$(awk 'BEGIN{in=0;d=0}
/ap_uint\s*<\s*1\s*>\s*check_token\s*\(/ {in=1}
{ if(in){print; for(i=1;i<=length($0);i++){c=substr($0,i,1); if(c=="{")d++; else if(c=="}")d--; } if(in && d==0 && $0 ~ /}/){exit} } }' "$SRC")

# FR2: compile-time constant expected token array in TU
if grep -Eq "\b(constexpr|const)\b[^\n;]*\bap_uint\s*<\s*8\s*>\b[^\n;]*\[\s*16\s*\]" "$SRC"; then pass FR2; else fail FR2 "no const/constexpr ap_uint<8>[16] found"; fi

# FR3: no obvious OS/I/O
if grep -Eq "\b(printf|fprintf|puts|putchar|scanf|iostream|cout|cerr|fstream|ofstream|ifstream|system\s*\(|popen\s*\(|fopen\s*\(|open\s*\()" "$SRC"; then fail FR3 "found I/O/OS facility usage"; else pass FR3; fi

# FR4: bounded loops only (heuristic)
if printf "%s" "$BODY" | grep -Eq "\b(while|do)\b"; then fail FR4 "while/do-while detected";
else
  badfor=$(printf "%s" "$BODY" | grep -n "for[[:space:]]*(" | grep -Ev "<[^;]*(16|0x10)|<=\s*15|!=\s*16" || true)
  if [ -n "$badfor" ]; then fail FR4 "for-loop without obvious constant bound (15/16)"; else pass FR4; fi
fi

# SR4: exact signature
if grep -Eq "ap_uint\s*<\s*1\s*>\s+check_token\s*\(\s*const\s+ap_uint\s*<\s*8\s*>\s+token\s*\[\s*16\s*\]\s*\)" "$SRC"; then pass SR4; else fail SR4 "top-level signature mismatch"; fi

# SR5: no static non-const
if grep -Eq "\bstatic\b(?![^\n]*\b(const|constexpr)\b)" "$SRC"; then fail SR5 "static non-const storage detected"; else pass SR5; fi

# SR1: no early exit primitives; single return
retcnt=$(printf "%s" "$BODY" | grep -E "\breturn\b" -n | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if printf "%s" "$BODY" | grep -Eq "\bbreak\s*;|\bgoto\b"; then fail SR1 "break/goto detected";
elif [ "${retcnt:-0}" -ne 1 ]; then fail SR1 "expected exactly 1 return in check_token body, found $retcnt";
else pass SR1; fi

# SR2: secret-dependent branches (heuristic)
if printf "%s" "$BODY" | grep -Eq "\bif\s*\([^\)]*(token\s*\[|expected\s*\[|diff|mismatch)[^\)]*\)"; then
  fail SR2 "branch condition depends on token/expected/mismatch"
elif printf "%s" "$BODY" | grep -Eq "\?[^:;]*(token\s*\[|expected\s*\[|diff|mismatch)"; then
  fail SR2 "ternary depends on token/expected/mismatch"
else pass SR2; fi

# SR3: no secret-dependent addressing; token/expected indexed only by induction var
idx=$(printf "%s" "$BODY" | awk 'match($0,/for\s*\(.*;\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*(<|!=)\s*(16|0x10)|for\s*\(\s*int\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*0\s*;\s*\4\s*(<|!=)\s*(16|0x10)/,m){print (m[1]!=""?m[1]:m[4]); exit}')
[ -z "$idx" ] && idx=i

# Remove likely declarations, then scan subscripts
ACCESS=$(printf "%s\n" "$BODY" | grep -Ev "^\s*(static\s+)?(const\s+|constexpr\s+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:<>]*\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*\[[^\]]+\]" || true)

# token/expected must be indexed by idx (allow trivial cast)
if printf "%s" "$ACCESS" | grep -Eq "token\s*\[\s*(\(int\)\s*)?${idx}\s*\]"; then :; fi
if printf "%s" "$ACCESS" | grep -Eq "token\s*\[(?!\s*(\(int\)\s*)?${idx}\s*\])"; then fail SR3 "token indexed by non-induction expression";
elif printf "%s" "$ACCESS" | grep -Eq "expected\s*\[(?!\s*(\(int\)\s*)?${idx}\s*\])"; then fail SR3 "expected indexed by non-induction expression";
elif printf "%s" "$ACCESS" | grep -Eq "\[[^\]]*(token\s*\[|expected\s*\[|diff|mismatch)[^\]]*\]" | grep -Ev "(token|expected)\s*\["; then
  fail SR3 "array indexed by token/expected/mismatch-derived value"
else pass SR3; fi

exit $rc

manifest.purpose: C-simulation functional testbench for check_token; validates exact match, single-byte mismatches at every index 0..15, multi-mismatch, and randomized regression; emits [PASS]/[FAIL] FR1.
Build/run C-sim with g++; generates a small ap_int.h/ap_uint shim if vendor header absent; shim supports integral ops and const-correct compound bitwise assignment operators.

PandA-Bambu synthesis smoke-check when available; classifies infra missing-header/toolchain issues as [NOT_RUN], tool internal crashes as [NOT_RUN], and genuine design/synth errors as [FAIL]; emits FR-4 markers.
Conservative cosim stub; emits [NOT_RUN] COSIM marker.

Static interface/security checks for FR2-FR4 and SR1-SR5; scans function body for early-exit, secret-dependent branches/addressing, extra I/O, and static non-const state; emits explicit [PASS]/[FAIL] markers for each requirement.

requirement_map.expected_detection: Exact expected token returns 1; any 1-byte mismatch at each index 0..15 returns 0; multi-mismatch returns 0; randomized regression: only exact expected token returns 1.
Static heuristic: compile-time const/constexpr ap_uint<8> array of length 16 present in same translation unit (inside or outside function).

Static grep rejects printf/cout/fstream/system and similar non-synthesizable I/O/library facilities; synthesis smoke-check attempts compilation when bambu is available (infra failures reported as NOT_RUN).
Static check rejects while/do-while and for-loops lacking obvious constant bound (15/16); synthesis smoke-check via bambu (FR-4 marker) when available; infra/tool issues reported as NOT_RUN.
Reject early exit indicators in check_token body: break/goto; multiple returns; return inside loop body.
Reject secret-dependent branches: if/?: conditions referencing token[...] or expected[...] or mismatch accumulators.

Reject secret-dependent addressing: array subscripts (excluding declarations) where index depends on token/expected/diff/mismatch; enforce token/expected indexed only by loop induction variable over 0..15.
Interface conformance: signature must be ap_uint<1> check_token(const ap_uint<8> token[16]); and no extra I/O/debug constructs.
Reject static non-const variables (global or local-static); allow only static const/constexpr (e.g., embedded expected token).
